說明(中文): Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

效果(英文): Causes the Pokémon to reuse an already consumed Berry at the end of the next turn.
說明(中文): When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

效果(英文): Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.
說明(中文): When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

效果(英文): Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
說明(中文): Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

效果(英文): Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.
說明(中文): The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

效果(英文): Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.
說明(中文): If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

效果(英文): Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.
說明(中文): Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

效果(英文): When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.
說明(中文): When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP

效果(英文): When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.
說明(中文): When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

效果(英文): This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.
說明(中文): ＨＰ變為一半時，會慌慌張張逃走，退回同行隊伍裡面。

效果(英文): Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.
說明(中文): 會提高我方的特殊招式的威力。

效果(英文): If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
說明(中文): 當寶可夢沒有攜帶道具時，會撿回第１個投出後捕捉失敗的精靈球。
